questions.question: If (sinA + cosA)/(sinA – cosA) = 5, find the value of sin⁴A + cos⁴A
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

(sinA + cosA)/(sinA – cosA) = 5

**CONCEPT:**

Use of trigonometric identities.

**FORMULA USED:**

SinA/CosA = TanA

Sec²A = 1 + Tan²A

Sin²A = 1 – Cos²A

**CALCULATION:**

(sinA + cosA)/(sinA – cosA) = 5,

⇒ sinA + cosA = 5sinA – 5cosA

⇒ 4sinA = 6cosA

⇒ tanA = 3/2

sec²A = 1 + tan²A = 1 + (3/2)² = 13/4

⇒ secA = √13/2

⇒ cosA = 2/√13

⇒ sin²A = 1 – cos²A = 1 – 4/13 = 9/13

⇒ sinA = 3/√13

∴ sin⁴A + cos⁴A

= (3/√13)⁴ + (2/√13)⁴

= (81 + 16)/169

= 97/169

questions.question: If CosA Cosec81° = 1, determine Cos⁵10A + Sin⁵10A
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

CosA Cosec81° = 1

**CONCEPT:**

Find the value of ‘A’ to get the value of the given expression.

**FORMULA USED:**

CosecA = 1/SinA

**CALCULATION:**

CosA Cosec81° = 1

⇒ CosA = Sin81°

⇒ A + 81° = 90°

⇒ A = 9°

⇒ 10A = 90°

∴ cos⁵10A + sin⁵10A

= cos⁵90° + sin⁵90°

= 0 + 1

= 1

questions.question: If sec(θ + α)/sec(θ – α) = a/b, then find the value of (cotθ.cotα).
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

sec(θ + α)/sec(θ – α) = a/b

**FORMULA USED:**

cos (A + B) = cosA cosB – sinA sinB

cos (A – B) = cosA cosB + sinA sinB

**CALCULATION:**

sec(θ + α)/sec(θ - α) = a/b

⇒ cos(θ – α)/cos(θ + α) = a/b

⇒ (cosθ.cosα + sinθ.sinα)/(cosθ.cosα - sinθ.sinα) = a/b

Dividing numerator and denominator by Sinθ.Sinα

⇒ (cotθ.cotα + 1)/(cotθ.cotα - 1) = a/b

⇒ b × cotθ.cotα + b = a × cotθ.cotα – a

⇒ a × cotθ.cotα – b × cotθ.cotα = a + b

⇒ cotθ.cotα = (a + b)/(a – b)

∴ cotθ.cotα = (a + b)/(a – b)

questions.question: If sin θ = 12/13, then find the value of 2cot θ + 13cos θ.
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

Sin θ = Perpendicular/hypotenuse , Cos θ= base/hypotenuse, cot θ = base/perpendicular 

Sin θ = 12/13

∴ Perpendicular = 12, hypotenuse = 13,

By Pythagoras theorem,

Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + base²

13² ⁼= 12² + base²

⇒ base² = 169 – 144

⇒ base = √ 25

⇒ base = 5

Cot θ = 5/12, cos θ = 5/13

**Calculation:**

2 cot θ + 13 cos θ = 2(5/12) + 13 (5 / 13)

⇒ (5/6) + 5

⇒ 35/6

**Short Trick:**

Pythagorean triplet:

5, 12, 13

Base= 5, Perpendicular = 12, Hypotenuse = 13

**Calculation:**

2 cot θ + 13 cos θ = 2(5/12) + 13(5/13)

⇒ (5/6) + 5

⇒ 35/6
